conclusion_ko: 목표 정의 차이와 합성 자체의 경계 분류 실패가 공존한다. 실사 exact-pixel GT가 없어 실사 오류를 두 원인으로 정확히 분해할 수 없다.
synthetic_near_scope: VAL valid query + valid renderer reference coordinate/pixel + distance<=3px; one additional <=3px query has out-of-frame reference and is excluded.
architecture_hypotheses: P3 9x9 + global average pooling does not explicitly read the query pixel.
Raw P3 stride about10.5px,18.5px in some wood images is coarser than the exact pixel label.
Current probabilities track patch occupancy strongly; spatial query readout is a proposed intervention, not tested.
not_established: Fraction of real errors due to label mismatch versus exact-pixel domain-transfer failure.
Causal responsibility of GAP, stride, crop scale, illumination or domain.
Equivalence of renderer projected cuboid pixel membership or external-ray proxy to human semantic DIRECT.
